Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E033.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a full-time Analyst requesting admin access to Payroll. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so as a full-time employee whose role does not own the system, her maximum access is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E033 as a contractor with basic training (HR note listed full_time, but security record is authoritative here). Contractors with basic training max out at read; never admin. Recommend read.
reason: Security record (authoritative) shows E033 Jennifer Martin is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training max out at read and can never be granted admin. The requested admin level exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E033: Jennifer Martin requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two notes with conflicting information:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommendation read. Comment says security record is authoritative; contractor max read.

Access policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role. Analyst does not own Payroll.

If employee is contractor with basic training: max is read. So grant read.
If employee is full-time Analyst: max write, but requested admin -> grant write.

The security note says security record is authoritative. The approver should decide. The security record indicates contractor with basic training. So max access is read. Requested admin is above max, so grant maximum = read.

Let me submit decision: read.

Evidence: Security note indicates E033 is a contractor with basic training; contractors max out at read (never admin). Requested admin exceeds max, so grant read.
